about.ru: Transitions (Female Vocal Version) — драматическая неоклассическая баллада, разворачивающаяся от уязвимого фортепианного соло к мощной кинематографической кульминации с парящим женским вокалом.
about.en: Transitions (Female Vocal Version) is a dramatic neoclassical ballad that evolves from a delicate, vulnerable piano motif into a sweeping cinematic crescendo driven by soaring female vocals.

shortDescription.ru: Transitions (Female Vocal Version) — драматическая неоклассическая баллада, разворачивающаяся от уязвимого фортепианного соло к мощной кинематографической кульминации с парящим женским вокалом.
shortDescription.en: Transitions (Female Vocal Version) is a dramatic neoclassical ballad that evolves from a delicate, vulnerable piano motif into a sweeping cinematic crescendo driven by soaring female vocals.

description.ru:
«Transitions» — это глубокая исповедь о проживании предельной душевной боли, утраты и последующего духовного перерождения. Образы разорванных крыльев, мартовского холода и бездны передают момент, когда рушатся прежние опоры, а эго сгорает в огне испытаний.

Однако в этой тьме прорастает рассвет: словно вербные почки в дыхании весны, душа сбрасывает оковы отчаяния. Песня утверждает алхимию внутренней трансформации — способность переплавить крик, невыплаканные слёзы и переломы прошлого в чистый, безусловный свет любви.
description.en:
"Transitions" is an intimate confession exploring the depths of emotional grief, surrender, and spiritual rebirth. Through poignant imagery of broken roads, torn wings, and winter’s unyielding frost, the track confronts the collapse of old boundaries and the painful dissolution of the ego.

Yet beneath the weight of sorrow lies the quiet promise of renewal — awakening like willow buds in the breath of spring. The piece becomes a powerful testament to emotional alchemy: the courageous act of melting anguish and silent tears into an enduring, boundless ray of love.

lyrics.ru:
Broken roads beneath my feet — transitions,
Tears and smoke, the night breathes heavy visions.
Pale and lost, I’ve wandered through the pain,
Once was joy, now silence falls like rain.

I did not birth — I let it crash into the void,
All my fears, my cries, the grief I could not avoid.
Couldn’t stand the truth my mind had tried to hold,
My breast was bound, the nurture cut away, cold.

Pain will wash me, sorrow sewn within,
March has torn my wings, yet I rise again.
Where is faith when time seems blind and cold?
I melt my cry, my grief, into love untold.

Willow buds awaken in the breath of spring,
Breaking chains, soft light on every trembling soul.
Through the fire of loss, my ego falls away,
My scream, my pain, now flows into love’s ray.

Every shadow, every tear I’ve known,
Every fracture, every bone —
Transforms in the light that softly grows,
From winter pain to the spring that glows.

Pain has washed me, sorrow sewn within,
March has torn my wings, yet I rise again.
Where is faith when time seems blind and cold?
I melt my cry, my grief, into love untold.

Transitions... transitions...
Through the pain — I rise to love again...
